$comment: The consumer layout contract (#1171): one visible clossys/ folder per repository, one subfolder per role, replacing strategy/ at the repository root and the hidden .clossys/. Launcher scaffolds clossys/README.md and clossys/.state/, migrating its own hub marker and inventory (and the packed skeleton template that seeds them) from the pre-#1171 .clossys/ path. Other roles adopt their own clossys/<role>/ folder on their own schedule; this contract is the shared shape they converge on.

monorepoRootKey.description: A monorepo may place clossys/ inside a workspace package instead of the repository root by setting this key in its own package.json or a foundry.config.json at the repository root.

rules: One owner per subfolder, named for the role the client talks to (@clossys-strategist -> clossys/strategist/). No two roles write the same folder.
Visible, not hidden: these are the business's own records. Only machine files go under clossys/.state/; there is no separate .clossys/.
Removing a role removes its folder.
Monorepos: one configuration key (see monorepoRootKey) may place clossys/ inside a workspace package; the default is the repository root.

folders.description: Generated index: active roles, what each folder holds, last change. Rewritten on every launcher run; never hand-edited.
Roles this repository adopts or declines, with reasons (#395, #1168).

Why each role is staffed here, its goals, handoffs, and sequence. The approved composed kit becomes this file (#1176). Written by the apply-plan step (#1178, wave 2); this entry is the layout position only.
Assessment input, plan, next action, PLAN.md. Exists on the account hub only, never on a product checkout.
Facts, audiences, positioning, claims, brand, direction. Replaces strategy/ at the repository root.

Surface documents: which template, which sections, which copy ids and asset ids, all by reference (#1205). Publisher is the only writer; Designer and Writer own everything a document references, propose changes in their own folders, and never edit a file here. Unlike the rest of clossys/publisher, a surface document is an approved record revised by reviewable diff, not append-only proof. Matches @clossys/publisher's PUBLISHER_SURFACES_DIR and the shipped site template, which reads clossys/publisher/surfaces/*.json at build time.
Machine files: hub marker (workspace.json), inventory (inventory.json), skills manifest (skills.json, #1183). Not a place a person edits by hand.

gitPolicy.description: What gets committed, by kind of output. Launcher's .gitignore entries cover only the last row -- generated run output -- never approved records, proof, or machine state.

rows.examples: strategy, copy, brand bindings, rules, plan
rows.note: every change is a reviewable diff
launcher writes .gitignore entries; convention is clossys/<role>/.generated/

approval: Approval is a merged pull request, the same standing rule every skill already states -- a chat approved is not authorization. A consumer may route clossys/<role>/ through CODEOWNERS so the right person must approve each role's changes.
